text: Because traditional fiat VC funds must maintain liquidity to support capital calls from their investors, they are limited in their ability to deploy capital, which affects their return on investment and overall fund performance.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, REPUTATION AS CAPITAL – How Decentralized Autonomous Organizations Address Shortcomings in the Ventu (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3962614
